title: SettleCraft
description: Create and manage towns claim land, set permissions, and see territory on Xaero's World Map.
body:
**Description:**

SettleCraft is a server-side town management mod for Fabric 1.21.1 that lets players build communities, claim territory, and control who can do what on their land.

**Getting started**

Any player can create a town with `/town create <name>` and immediately become its Mayor. From there, claim the chunks that make up your town's territory, invite members, and configure your town however you like.

**Territory**

Mayors claim land chunk by chunk using `/town claim` while standing in the chunk they want. Claimed territory is visible on [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) as a coloured overlay. Your own town's claims appear in blue, other towns' claims in red. Towns can hold up to 64 claimed chunks.

**Permissions**

Mayors have full control over what guests and members can do inside town borders. Each of the following can be toggled independently for both groups:

- Build and break blocks
- PvP
- Interact with blocks (chests, doors, buttons, etc.)
- Mob spawning

**Towns on your SMP**

Players can join and leave towns freely. Your town name appears in chat alongside your name so everyone knows who's where. Mayors can set a Message of the Day that greets members when they log in, kick troublesome members, rename the town, transfer ownership, or disband entirely. Mayors can also ban players from other towns from entering their territory.

**Commands**

Use `/town help` in-game for the full command list. Key ones: `/town create`, `/town join`, `/town leave`, `/town claim`, `/town info`, `/town setperm`, `/town ban`, `/town map`.

**Installation**

SettleCraft is server-side, meaning it runs without any client installation. However, to see town territory on [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map), players should also install it on their client. Xaero's World Map is not required, it is an optional visual enhancement.

Requires Fabric Loader 0.16.5+ and Fabric API for Minecraft 1.21.1.

Report any bugs to the discord server.
